7084-7201-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2034-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

401-2530-3944-5332.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-5332.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-7452--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2169-6495--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing your creatures to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2
2169-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

206-1563-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

215-969-1376.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-969-1376.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-7704.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-7704.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-3112-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

4052-6264-7435.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
4052-6264-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Repeat.
During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each card discarded this way.
When the Zombie(s) enter the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers that many times, causing you to draw that many cards.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat from step 2.

1250-5932-6850.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand or in your graveyard.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have one or more basic land cards in your library.
1250-5932-6850.description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for all basic land cards and putting them onto the top of your library.
Play a land.
When the land enters, Icetill Explorer triggers, causing you to mill a card.
As the milled card will be a land, Hedge Shredder's second ability triggers, putting the land from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat step 3 until you do not mill a land.
1250-5932-6850.notes: Rather than playing a land, you can instead attack with Hedge Shredder to trigger its first ability. This skips step 2, and starts the loop at step 4 instead of at step 3.

527-955-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

2292-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

30-141-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-6797.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-6797.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

3372-5231-6006-6965.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-5231-6006-6965.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2292-2478-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1492-2866-3967-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-3967-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

500-813-1777.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scholar of the Ages and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Scholar of the Ages tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand along with up to two other instants and/or sorceries.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Scholar of the Ages token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

2292-4484-4871-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

997-2882-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
997-2882-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
997-2882-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2955-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Justiciar's Portal.
813-2955-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1306-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Crypt's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1618-4872-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-4872-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-4872-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Warp and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Time Warp and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Time Warp and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Warp's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-4872-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

4055-4222-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4055-4222-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4055-4222-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2527-2921-3143-3464.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-2921-3143-3464.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1069-1322-2457-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1322-2457-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1309-1885-2639-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mitotic Slime and Salvager of Secrets, adding {W}{W}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {G}{G}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Eerie Ultimatum by paying {W}{W}{B}{B}{B}{G}{G}, returning Salvager of Secrets and Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eerie Ultimatum from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

806-1300.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing nonland permanents, one of which must be able to produce at least {G}.
You control another creature that can attack this turn.
Curse of Bounty attached to any opponent.
806-1300.description:
Declare any creature you control as an attacker, attacking the opponent with Curse of Bounty attached, triggering Curse of Bounty.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Curse of Bounty's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Curse of Bounty's trigger, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-4091-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-4091-5200.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Aphetto Alchemist.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

549-1902-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
549-1902-1978.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat

238-3604-5231.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
238-3604-5231.description:
Cast Gerrard either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gerrard enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Gerrard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the nontoken Gerrard, adding {R}.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the token Gerrard, adding {R}.
The token Gerrard dies, returning the nontoken Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Gerrard triggers, exiling it if it's in your graveyard and returning all artifacts and creatures that were put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
